brief_tokens_S3: No cell is an observed UI or fallback run
aggregate_judgment: Three of nine host surfaces document MCP Apps rendering: Claude Desktop, GitHub Copilot in VS Code, and Cursor. That is a documentation-based starting set; build and registration path still need verifying, and no fallback has been verified by a run anywhere.
shipping_action: Ship the portable path regardless: readable text plus an optional image as ordinary tool content. Do not rely on app-only tool visibility to hide a tool from the model; it is unverified on every host.
banner_core: Evidence, not test results. Everything here comes from vendor documentation, dated user or staff reports, one pinned VS Code source snapshot, or local file inspection whose receipts are private and not linked. No cell is an observed UI or fallback run. "Unknown" means this evidence does not establish the answer; it is not "unsupported".
product_sentences_verbatim: Claude Desktop — the vendor guide documents inline Apps; issue reports are mixed; reported fallbacks are a blank gap and an error card. Not run here.
GitHub Copilot in VS Code — vendor blog and release notes; pinned source (not a shipped build) carries Apps version 2026-01-26 and a user setting. Not run here.
Cursor — vendor docs; a rendering regression in 3.10 reported fixed in 3.12 (forum, Jul 2026); staff say no toggle or account enablement exists (Jul–Aug 2026). Not run here.

Claude Cowork — dated reports: first-party apps rendered and a gateway third-party server showed plain text (Apr 2026); a plugin showed raw JSON (May 2026). No Cowork-specific vendor guide; the Claude guide names Cowork only in navigation.

OpenAI Codex Desktop — the app bundle contains Apps sandbox and schema code and an internal gate whose in-code default is false; its runtime value is unknown. Vendor docs are silent. Nothing observed rendering.
Claude Code — docs cover standard MCP only; no retained inspection evidence here; Apps behavior unverified.
OpenAI Codex CLI — docs silent; no retained inspection evidence here; Apps behavior unverified.
Antigravity CLI — docs silent; no retained inspection evidence here; Apps behavior unverified.
Antigravity Desktop — build 2.2.1 searched for named Apps strings, none found; the current 2.13.0 (Sep 9 2026) was not inspected; docs and changelog are silent.
